cell.name: 3-5__critical
cell.rationale: no internal reflection: the 22 deg halo path on the canonical column (tests/test_discovery.py's production scene); next to an interior extremum of D_P (a caustic): a short loop around a Jacobian-degenerate point

selection.method: lit side of an interior extremum of D_P

sample.sampler: antipodal Fibonacci lattice (docs/phase1-math-contract.md section 9.5.2), kept events w > 0

closed_arclength_relative.basis: docs/phase1-math-contract.md section 10.1: discrete lengths of one 3-5 loop span 0.0017 on 0.9645 (1.8e-3 relative) across initial steps 0.03-0.08; an arc's length is compared only from the same seed (section 9.5.6); arcs are not compared

counts_and_events.basis: exact: the pool is the exported band (section 9.5.8)

curve_distance_rad.basis: docs/phase1-math-contract.md section 10.1: bidirectional sampled-pose set distance below 0.012 rad between two step-controller settings on the 3-5 loop; measured here against the geodesic polyline (curve_distance), which removes the chord-sampling part of that distance

kind_status_reasons.basis: exact, per component in trace order (section 9.5.5); an arc's {reason, start_reason} unordered

seed_to_curve_rad.basis: the call's distance_threshold: the contract's own 'this pose is on that component' test (section 9.5.4 step 5)
